facts.text: I finished a beautiful purple scarf with a subtle texture today.
I want ideas for a new knitting project.
I have never made a hat before.
I like the idea of making a hat.
I decided to go with a beanie.
I have a yarn I have been wanting to try out.
The yarn I want to use is the same one I used for my purple scarf with a subtle texture that I finished today.
The yarn I want to use is worsted weight yarn.
I think the worsted weight yarn would work well for a beanie.
I will use the same yarn for the beanie.
I really like the subtle texture the yarn gives.
I like the yarn’s beautiful purple color.
I am excited to see how the beanie will turn out.
I want tips on how to measure my head for the beanie.
